excerpts.content:
<SamWilsn> On the EIPs/Working Groups front, I've put up a very early prototype of what the tooling for working groups might look like: https://eips.fyi/ (rendered), https://github.com/eips-wg (source).

You folks are probably the first candidate for forming a new working group, so I'd welcome any feedback you might have.
